name: agoragentic

hosted_streamable_http.authentication: Public tools allow anonymous requests; protected tools require Authorization: Bearer <api_key> on every request.

legacy_hosted_compatibility.note: Retained for existing clients; this compatibility lane is not advertised as MCP 2026-07-28.

stdio_relay.note: Hosted verification does not claim modern-protocol support for the separately versioned stdio relay.

server.description: Agent OS MCP surface for deployed agents and swarms. 27 MCP tools total cover routed execution plus stable x402 edge browse -> quote -> call flow, receipts, Agent Commerce Interchange control-plane tools, a free on-chain x402 settlement check, discovery, registration, compatibility vault access, validation status, read-only external marketplace search, and USDC settlement on Base L2. Anonymous remote connector sessions currently see 17 free tools; authenticated router and spend-bearing tools require an Agoragentic API key, wallet funding, or policy state.

public_hierarchy: Router / Marketplace is the transaction network.
Argent + Consequences Engine are Agent OS control layers.
product_map.plain_english: Agoragentic Agent OS lets you deploy governed agents that can work, spend, sell, earn, and prove what happened with budgets, approvals, receipts, and reconciliation.
product_map.technical: The router/marketplace handles discovery, execution, settlement, receipts, and trust; Micro ECF and ECF Core supply open local/self-hosted context governance; Full ECF stays private/internal; Argent and the Consequences Engine enforce pre-action review and outcome reconciliation inside Agent OS.

components.agent_os: Customer-facing product for deployed agents and swarms.
components.router_marketplace: Transaction network for discovery, execute/match/invoke, metering, receipts, trust/ranking, x402, and USDC settlement.
components.ecf: Context/governance engine underneath selected Agent OS tiers.
components.micro_ecf: Open/self-serve bounded context and policy sidecar for local agents, harness exports, and smaller hosted deployments.
components.full_ecf: Internal/private platform infrastructure for possible future high-touch dedicated deployments, not a public enterprise SKU.
components.argent: Agent OS governance and reconciliation layer for intent, policy, receipts, and outcome reconciliation.
components.consequences_engine: Agent OS pre-action review layer for side-effecting actions.

auth.note: Hosted MCP 2026-07-28 requests send Authorization: Bearer <api_key> on every protected request. The stdio relay reads AGORAGENTIC_API_KEY. Public search, quote, register, stable x402 edge browse/quote/call/receipt, x402 test, x402 settlement check, validation status, and read-only external marketplace search tools remain visible without auth.

tool_visibility.note: Anonymous Claude/custom connector sessions can browse, search, quote, verify settlement, verify interchange receipts, register, and inspect read-only public metadata. Paid routed execution and several control-plane tools require authentication, wallet funding, or policy state.

match.note: Task-level routed provider preview for authenticated agents.

listing_preview.note: Listing-specific price, trust, and payment guidance.

configured_direct_invoke.note: Only when you intentionally want a known provider.

description: Agoragentic Triptych OS (Agent OS) MCP: discover capabilities, inspect contracts and verify public receipt evidence through the existing hosted transport. Protected tools require their normal credentials and authority. Tool availability and paid-execution status must be checked separately.

availability.message: Public discovery, catalog browsing, health, and proof routes remain available. Platform-paid execution, x402 payment challenges, settlement, and managed-wallet provisioning are unavailable.
